slides.title: What is a Fraction? 🍕
slides.text: A fraction is a way of describing a part of a whole! When a pizza, a chapati, or a chocolate bar is divided into EQUAL parts, each part is a fraction of that whole.
slides.spoken: A fraction is a way of describing a part of a whole! When a pizza or a chapati is divided into equal parts, each part is a fraction of that whole.

slides.title: Numerator & Denominator! 🔢
slides.text: The bottom number is the DENOMINATOR — it tells us how many equal parts the whole is divided into. The top number is the NUMERATOR — it tells how many parts we are taking!
slides.spoken: The bottom number is the denominator, telling us total equal parts. The top number is the numerator, telling how many parts we take!

slides.title: Types of Fractions! 🧁
slides.text: LIKE fractions have the same denominator (like 2/7 and 3/7). UNLIKE fractions have different denominators (like 1/2 and 1/3). UNIT fractions have numerator 1 (like 1/2, 1/4, 1/8)!
slides.spoken: Like fractions have the same denominator. Unlike fractions have different denominators. Unit fractions have numerator 1!

slides.title: Equivalent Fractions! ✨
slides.text: Equivalent fractions look different but represent the exact same quantity! For example, 1/2, 2/4, and 3/6 all shade the exact same half of a shape!
slides.spoken: Equivalent fractions look different but represent the exact same quantity! For example, 1/2, 2/4, and 3/6 all equal one half!

slides.title: Adding & Subtracting Like Fractions! ➕➖
slides.text: When adding or subtracting like fractions, the denominator stays EXACTLY the same! We only add or subtract the numerators: 3/7 + 2/7 = 5/7!
slides.spoken: When adding or subtracting like fractions, the denominator stays exactly the same! We only add or subtract the numerators!

challenges.question: What is a FRACTION?
challenges.answer: A part of a whole, where the whole is divided into equal parts
options: A part of a whole, where the whole is divided into equal parts
A type of whole number used for counting objects
A special way to multiply numbers together
challenges.hint: Think about sharing a chapati or pizza equally among friends!
challenges.misconception: A fraction is always a part of a whole divided into EQUAL parts! If parts are unequal, it is not a proper fraction.
